description: Small manually authored smoke-test benchmark for the FASTFACT-inspired prototype. Not a statistically representative evaluation dataset.

cases.prompt: Describe how DraftGuard verifies checkpoint integrity.
cases.draft: Checkpoint snapshots are protected with a SHA-256 digest.

evidence.text: Checkpoint snapshots are serialized as canonical JSON and protected with a SHA-256 digest. The runtime recomputes the digest before restoring a snapshot.

cases.draft: The application stores user passwords in plaintext.

evidence.text: The application does not store user passwords. Authentication secrets must not be written into task content, checkpoint snapshots, or audit logs.

cases.draft: Every artifact is encrypted with AES-256 before being stored.

evidence.text: The artifact store writes versioned checkpoint snapshots to a local Git repository and records the snapshot SHA-256 digest for integrity verification. This source does not specify encryption at rest.
